description: Rb₃Na(MoO₄)₂ crystallizes in the trigonal P̅3m1 space group. There are two inequivalent Rb sites. In the first Rb site, Rb is bonded in a 10-coordinate geometry to ten O atoms. There are a spread of Rb-O bond distances ranging from 2.68-3.36 Å. In the second Rb site, Rb is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six equivalent O atoms. All Rb-O bond lengths are 3.13 Å. Na is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent MoO₄ tetrahedra. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.49 Å. Mo is bonded to four O atoms to form MoO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 18°. There is one shorter (1.78 Å) and three longer (1.81 Å) Mo-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to four Rb, one Na, and one Mo atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to one Rb and one Mo atom.
